title: What Is Velositol? What Does It Do When Taken With Protein?
seoTitle: What Is Velositol? What Does It Do With Protein?
dek: What is Velositol, and how does it work? Explore the ingredient, its mechanism of action, and the research behind Velositol and MyoVera.
author: Velositol.co Editorial Team

featuredImage.alt: Velositol and MyoVera shown alongside a protein source in an editorial nutrition setting

socialImage.alt: Social preview for What Is Velositol and what it does when taken with protein

body.html: Velositol® is an ingredient increasingly found in protein powders, sports nutrition formulas, and select muscle-support products. Despite its growing presence on ingredient labels, Velositol is not a protein, an amino acid, or a new form of creatine.
Velositol is a patented amylopectin-chromium ingredient studied for use alongside protein and its short-term effects on muscle protein production.

body.title: In simple terms
body.html: Velositol is designed to complement protein, not replace it.
What Is Velositol?
Velositol combines amylopectin with two forms of chromium:

Amylopectin is a branched-chain carbohydrate. Trivalent chromium is the form of chromium used in foods and dietary supplements. According to the National Institutes of Health (NIH), chromium may play a role in carbohydrate, fat, and protein metabolism through its influence on insulin activity, though the exact mechanism is not fully established.

Velositol does not provide the amino acids that muscles need. Those amino acids still come from foods, whey protein, or plant protein. Velositol is used as an add-on to protein, not as a protein source itself.

body.alt: Illustration of amylopectin, chromium histidinate, and chromium picolinate in the Velositol complex
body.adminNote: Suggested placement: after the ingredient-composition explanation.

body.html: How Are Velositol and MyoVera Related?

Everwell Health now markets this ingredient under the brand name MyoVera™, a patented ingredient containing two forms of chromium, positioned to support protein utilization, muscle strength, and physical performance.

body.title: In short
body.html: MyoVera™ is the new brand name for the patented ingredient previously known as Velositol®.
What Does Velositol Do?
Most research on Velositol has examined its use alongside protein.

Researchers are still studying exactly how Velositol may work. Chromium may affect some processes related to insulin, while amylopectin provides a small amount of carbohydrate. However, the mechanism has not been fully established in humans.
Velositol does not build muscle on its own. Protein still supplies the amino acids needed to produce new muscle protein.
Research on Muscle Protein Synthesis
A 2017 randomized, double-blind, crossover study involving 10 participants compared:

items: 6 grams of whey protein plus 2 grams of the amylopectin-chromium complex

body.html: Researchers measured a greater short-term muscle protein synthesis response when the complex was taken with whey than when whey was taken alone.
This finding is often condensed into the claim that Velositol “doubles muscle protein synthesis.” That framing needs context:

items: It measured only the short-term response after a single dose
The whey dose used (6 grams) is a relatively low protein serving
The study did not measure long-term muscle gain over months

body.html: As a result, this data does not demonstrate that using Velositol will double a person's muscle mass.

body.alt: Comparison of the 2017 acute Velositol study and the eight-week resistance-training study
body.adminNote: Suggested placement: between the acute study and the eight-week study.

body.html: Eight-Week Resistance Training Research
A separate study followed 35 physically active men through eight weeks of resistance training. Participants were divided into three groups:

items: 2 grams of the amylopectin-chromium complex plus 15 grams of whey

body.html: The group taking the complex with 15 grams of whey completed more squat repetitions before stopping and improved on some vertical-jump measures. However, the researchers did not find a clear advantage in lean body mass or muscle size compared with the whey-only groups.
What Do These Results Mean?

The findings suggest that Velositol may be most relevant as an ingredient used with protein during a resistance-training routine. However, current research has not shown that it produces greater muscle growth.
Does Velositol Replace Protein?
No.
Both key human studies used the amylopectin-chromium complex alongside whey protein. Velositol has not been shown to replace a complete protein source.

body.title: The most accurate takeaway
body.html: Velositol works with protein, not instead of it.
Conclusion

Velositol is an amylopectin-chromium complex studied for use alongside protein. Early studies suggest that Velositol may affect short-term muscle protein production and certain exercise measures when used with whey protein. More research is needed to understand how meaningful these effects are over time.
However, current evidence does not demonstrate that Velositol replaces protein or doubles muscle gain.

body.html: One of the most common questions after learning about Velositol is: How much Velositol should I take?
The two human studies discussed in this article both used 2 grams of the amylopectin-chromium complex with whey protein.
Which Velositol Dose Has Been Studied?
The 2017 acute study used:
The eight-week resistance training study used:
In both studies, participants received 2 grams of the complex.

body.alt: The 2-gram Velositol amount used with whey protein in two human-study protocols
body.adminNote: Suggested placement: after the studied-dose section.

body.html: Take Velositol With Protein
Velositol is studied as an ingredient meant to complement protein intake.
In the eight-week study, participants took the product immediately after resistance exercise on training days. On rest days, they took it at the same time of day.
No study has directly compared:

items: Taking it before versus after training
Use with a shake versus a whole meal
Use with whey versus other protein sources

body.html: Because of this, the best-supported guidance is to take Velositol alongside a protein source, rather than trying to pinpoint an overly precise “anabolic window.”
Should You Take Velositol on Rest Days?

In the eight-week study, participants used the product on both training and non-training days. The study did not compare daily use with training-day-only use, so it cannot determine whether one schedule is more effective than the other.
Users should still follow the specific serving size and directions on their chosen product's label.
Short-Term Safety Findings and Limitations
In the eight-week study, researchers monitored:

items: Recovery, sleep, energy, and muscle soreness

body.html: Aside from a few statistical interactions in creatinine and aspartate aminotransferase that remained within clinical limits, most blood-based safety markers did not differ significantly between groups.

Most measured blood-based biomarkers did not differ significantly between groups during the eight-week study. These findings apply only to the participants, duration, dose, and measurements included in that study and do not establish long-term safety or safety across other populations.

body.alt: Summary of the short-term safety measurements and the evidence limitations for Velositol
body.adminNote: Suggested placement: after the short-term safety findings.

body.html: A Note on Chromium
MyoVera and Velositol contain chromium histidinate and chromium picolinate. Chromium may influence insulin activity, though the NIH notes that its exact mechanism is not yet fully understood.

The Food and Nutrition Board has not established a Tolerable Upper Intake Level (UL) for chromium due to insufficient data. The absence of a UL does not mean any amount of chromium is automatically safe. The NIH notes that individuals with liver or kidney conditions may be more sensitive to higher chromium intake.
What Medications Can Interact With Chromium?
The NIH has identified several potential interactions:

items: Chromium taken with insulin may increase the risk of hypoglycemia
Chromium may have an additive effect when combined with metformin or other diabetes medications
Chromium picolinate taken at the same time as levothyroxine may reduce drug absorption

body.html: Anyone taking these medications should speak with a physician or pharmacist before using a chromium-containing supplement.
Who Should Talk to a Healthcare Provider First?
Consult a healthcare provider before use if you:

items: Take insulin or other blood-sugar medication
Have a liver or kidney condition
Are taking one or more other chromium-containing supplements
Have a medical condition that is being monitored by a healthcare professional

body.html: Velositol should not be used as a treatment for diabetes, insulin resistance, or any medical condition.
Conclusion
The two cited human studies used 2 grams of the amylopectin-chromium complex alongside whey protein. These studies do not prove that 2 grams is the best dose for every person or every situation.

The eight-week study did not identify concerning signals across most safety biomarkers, though long-term evidence remains limited. Anyone taking medication or managing an underlying health condition should pay particular attention to chromium content.

body.html: After learning about Velositol, the next question is usually: Where can I buy Velositol?

Velositol can appear in protein powders, amino acid blends, creatine formulas, or as a standalone supplement. Before choosing a product, buyers should check not only the ingredient name but also the dosage, serving size, and supporting testing documentation.
Velositol or MyoVera: Which Name Should You Look For?

Everwell Health now markets this ingredient under the name MyoVera™. MyoVera is described as a patented ingredient containing two forms of chromium, developed to support muscle protein utilization, strength, and physical performance.

body.title: Ingredient name
body.html: MyoVera™ is the new brand name for the patented ingredient previously known as Velositol®.
Products already licensed under the Velositol name may continue to use that name and trademark. As a result, consumers may encounter either name while researching products.
Verify the Licensed Ingredient
Not every product combining amylopectin and chromium is automatically Velositol or MyoVera.
When evaluating a product, check for:

items: Use of the official Velositol® or MyoVera™ name
Attribution to the ingredient's rights holder
Clearly stated trademark or patent information

body.html: The published Velositol studies evaluated a specific amylopectin-chromium complex. Those results do not automatically apply to any generic blend containing similar-sounding ingredients.

body.alt: Checklist for verifying the licensed Velositol or MyoVera name, trademark, serving amount, and chromium disclosure
body.adminNote: Suggested placement: after the licensed-ingredient checklist.

body.html: Check the Velositol Amount Per Serving
Both published human studies used 2 grams of the amylopectin-chromium complex.
Buyers should check:

items: Whether the amount is listed per serving or per capsule
How many capsules or scoops make up one serving
Whether the formula provides 2 grams or a lower amount
Whether the label clearly discloses the chromium content

body.html: This doesn't mean a product providing less than 2 grams has no effect — but 2 grams is the amount that directly matches the published human study protocols.
Check the Certificate of Analysis
A Certificate of Analysis, or CoA, is a laboratory report for a specific production batch. It may show whether the product was tested for:
A CoA should be matched against the lot number on the product itself. A test report for an older lot doesn't necessarily represent every batch produced afterward.
Buyers should also distinguish between:

items: An actual CoA that includes a specific lab, method, results, and lot number

body.html: What Are the Advantages of a Standalone Capsule?
Velositol is often included in a protein powder or multi-ingredient blend, which can suit people who want every ingredient in one product.
A standalone capsule may be a better fit for people who:

items: Already have a preferred whey or plant protein
Don't want to switch flavors or protein brands
Want to know exactly how much Velositol they're taking
Want to separate Velositol from creatine, leucine, or other ingredients
Want to pair it with a protein-containing meal

body.html: A standalone format doesn't automatically make Velositol more effective. Its main advantage lies in serving-size control and flexibility with an existing protein routine.
VINATURA Velositol® 2G
VINATURA Velositol® 2G is a standalone capsule supplement that provides:

items: 2 grams of licensed Velositol® per serving

body.html: The product is intended to be taken alongside a protein-containing meal or shake. The 2-gram amount matches the dose of the complex used in the 2017 and 2021 human studies.

The VINATURA product page also publishes testing documentation for a specific lot, including identity, chromium content, microbial testing, and heavy metals. Buyers should check the current lot number to confirm which documentation applies to their product.

body.html: Where Can I Buy Velositol?

Consumers can check current availability of VINATURA Velositol® 2G on VINATURA's official product page. Pricing, stock, and shipping times may change, so it's best to confirm details directly at the time of purchase.
When buying Velositol or MyoVera from any brand, prioritize products that offer:

items: A CoA with a lot number
Clear manufacturer information and usage warnings

body.html: Conclusion

Where to buy is only part of the decision. What matters more is confirming that a product uses a licensed ingredient, provides an amount aligned with your goals, and offers transparent testing documentation.

VINATURA Velositol® 2G provides 2 grams of licensed Velositol in a standalone capsule, allowing users to keep their existing protein routine unchanged. This standalone format may suit people who want to add Velositol to their existing protein routine without changing their preferred protein powder, shake, or meal plan.
